title: Can System-1-Style Decision Models Replace Dedicated Rerankers in RAG? A Systems Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.34816v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems often use a dedicated reranker to choose which retrieved candidates reach the language model. Reranking improves relevance but adds latency, so teams look for faster alternatives. System-1style decision models make direct, structured predictions instead of generating long responses. Could one provide comparable reranking quality with less inference overhead? We first screen 21 open-weight models on 11 benchmarks, then compare a promising decision model with a dedicated reranker on identical candidate lists. The default decision-model setup fails on many long candidate sets, so scoring only the requests it completes gives a misleading ranking. Limiting candidate text length largely restores reliability and makes some configurations competitive. translated_title: System-1风格决策模型能否替代RAG中的专用重排序器？一项系统性评估
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统通常使用专用的重排序器来决定哪些检索到的候选内容会传递给语言模型。重排序可以提升相关性，但会增加延迟，因此研发团队寻求更快的替代方案。System-1风格的决策模型直接做出结构化预测，而不是生成长篇回复。这类模型能否以更少的推理开销提供相当的重排序质量？我们首先在11个基准测试上筛选了21个开放权重模型，然后在相同的候选列表上将一个有前景的决策模型与专用重排序器进行对比。默认的决策模型设置在许多长候选集上会失败，因此仅对其完成的请求进行评分会产生误导性的排名结果。限制候选文本长度在很大程度上恢复了可靠性，并使某些配置具备竞争力。在新检索数据上进行的冻结评估支持了可靠性和排名结论，但证实两个选定模型中仅有一个满足延迟要求。
tldr: 系统性评估表明，System-1风格决策模型只有在限制候选文本长度时才能与RAG专用重排序器相媲美，其默认设置在长候选集上不可靠，且两个候选模型中仅有一个满足延迟要求。
en_tdlr: A systems evaluation shows that System-1-style decision models can rival dedicated RAG rerankers only when candidate text length is limited, as their default setup is unreliable on long candidate lists, and only one of the two selected models meets the latency requirement.
